/// Running Godot version discovered before optional interface resolution.
version: Version,
getGodotVersion: Child(c.GDExtensionInterfaceGetGodotVersion),
getGodotVersion2: c.GDExtensionInterfaceGetGodotVersion2,
classdbConstructObject3: c.GDExtensionInterfaceClassdbConstructObject3,
classdbRegisterExtensionClass6: c.GDExtensionInterfaceClassdbRegisterExtensionClass6,
variantGetTypeByName: c.GDExtensionInterfaceVariantGetTypeByName,
pub const VersionProbe = struct {
    version: Version,
    getGodotVersion: Child(c.GDExtensionInterfaceGetGodotVersion),
};

pub fn probeVersion(getProcAddress: Child(c.GDExtensionInterfaceGetProcAddress)) VersionProbe {
    // get_godot_version is required by 4.1. get_godot_version2 may be optional,
    // so interface selection uses get_godot_version first.
    const get_godot_version: Child(c.GDExtensionInterfaceGetGodotVersion) = @ptrCast(getProcAddress("get_godot_version").?);
    var version: Version = undefined;
    get_godot_version(@ptrCast(&version));
    return .{ .version = version, .getGodotVersion = get_godot_version };
}

pub fn init(getProcAddress: Child(c.GDExtensionInterfaceGetProcAddress), library: Child(c.GDExtensionClassLibraryPtr)) DispatchTable {
    return initWithVersion(getProcAddress, library, probeVersion(getProcAddress));
}

pub fn initWithVersion(getProcAddress: Child(c.GDExtensionInterfaceGetProcAddress), library: Child(c.GDExtensionClassLibraryPtr), probe: VersionProbe) DispatchTable {

    return .{
        .library = library,
        .version = probe.version,
        .getGodotVersion = probe.getGodotVersion,
        .getGodotVersion2 = @ptrCast(getProcAddress("get_godot_version2").?),
        .classdbConstructObject3 = @ptrCast(getProcAddress("classdb_construct_object3").?),
        .classdbRegisterExtensionClass6 = @ptrCast(getProcAddress("classdb_register_extension_class6").?),
        .variantGetTypeByName = @ptrCast(getProcAddress("variant_get_type_by_name").?),
    };
}
